result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

The fix is in `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It adds `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count, the same predicate the per-quarter purchase order report uses. I also updated its Javadoc to say cancelled orders are not counted.

In `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java` I added a test, `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, that reproduces your example. It also gave the helper an overload that takes a status.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests). I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
